manifest.ext.name: Secrets-LE
manifest.ext.description: Detect and sanitize credentials, tokens, API keys, and private keys locally — before you commit. 100% local processing; nothing leaves your machine.
manifest.command.detect.title: Detect Secrets
manifest.command.detect-folder.title: Detect Secrets in Folder
manifest.command.sanitize.title: Sanitize Secrets
manifest.command.settings.title: Open Settings
manifest.command.help.title: Help & Troubleshooting
manifest.settings.title: Secrets-LE Settings
manifest.settings.clipboard.positions.de: Include each line and column in the copy on the clipboard. Only matters when the result is copied.
manifest.settings.copy.clipboard.desc: Automatically copy detection/sanitization results to the clipboard
manifest.settings.dedupe.desc: Enable automatic deduplication of detected secrets
manifest.settings.open.side-by-side.desc: Open detection results in a new editor to the side
Detection sensitivity level. Higher sensitivity detects more potential secrets but may increase false positives
Medium - Detect medium and high confidence secrets (default)
High - Detect all potential secrets (may have false positives)
manifest.settings.detection.include.api-: Include API keys in detection (AWS, Azure, GCP, generic)
manifest.settings.detection.include.toke: Include tokens in detection (JWT, OAuth, Bearer, etc.)
manifest.settings.detection.include.priv: Include private keys in detection (SSH, RSA, PGP)
manifest.settings.sanitization.replace-w: Text to use when replacing detected secrets
manifest.settings.safety.enabled.desc: Enable safety checks for large files and operations
Warn when input file size exceeds this threshold in bytes
manifest.settings.show.positions.desc: Show the line and column of each secret found
manifest.settings.statusbar.enabled.desc: Show Secrets-LE status bar entry for quick access
manifest.settings.telemetry.desc: Enable local-only telemetry logs to the Output panel
manifest.settings.workspace.patterns.des: Glob patterns of the files a folder or workspace scan reads
manifest.settings.workspace.default-excl: Skip dependency folders, build output, caches and lockfiles, such as node_modules, dist, .next and package-lock.json
manifest.settings.workspace.gitignore.de: Leave out the files the project's .gitignore files leave out
manifest.settings.workspace.binary.desc: Skip images, fonts, archives and other files that are not text
manifest.settings.workspace.excludes.des: Glob patterns of more files a folder or workspace scan skips, on top of the built-in list. Example: **/fixtures/**
manifest.settings.workspace.always-inclu: Glob patterns of files a folder or workspace scan reads even when the built-in list or .gitignore would skip them. Example: **/vendor/**
manifest.settings.workspace.max-files.de: The most files one folder or workspace scan reads
The most results one folder or workspace scan reports before it stops reading
manifest.settings.workspace.problems.des: Also show the secrets a scan finds in the Problems panel
manifest.mcp.label: Secrets-LE secret detection tools for agent mode
